components.heading: Purpose – Intent.
components.text: This district is established to provide for the use and location of all other uses excluded in other districts except for residential dwellings. The intensity and use of land as permitted by this district is intended to facilitate the total range of industrial uses. (Code 1995 § 48-21.00.)
